summary.text: Bernie Willis (Bernard Willis) is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 74 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia describes him as a career military pilot who reached the rank of colonel.

paragraphs.text: Willis was born in Louisville, Kentucky, and joined the U.S. Air Force.

He earned an associate degree from Marion Military Institute in 1987, a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1991 and a graduate degree from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 2018.

His career includes service as a federal law enforcement officer at the Springfield Air National Guard base and as an adjunct professor in unmanned aviation at Embry-Riddle and Sinclair Community College.

Willis defeated Democrat Derek Alvarado in the November 5, 2024 general election, and Ballotpedia lists his committees as Finance, Public Safety, Transportation (chair) and Veterans and Military Development.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 30-year Air Force, Air National Guard and Reserve officer and combat pilot, and listed cleanup of the Tremont City barrel fill, support for law enforcement and local control of schools among his priorities.
Darrell Jackson is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
